analysis.reading: TWO FINDINGS IN THE CITED SET. (1) CERN STILL SERVES A SEARCH PAGE FOR THE ARCHIVE. Card 2 is zenodo-rdm.web.cern.ch, titled "Search Crimson Hexagonal Archive - Zenodo - CERN", surfaced on 30 JULY — six weeks after the 19 June account termination. The records are gone; the CERN-hosted search surface for them is still indexed and still cited. (2) OPENALEX INDEXES A DELETED DOI. Card 8 is an OpenAlex Work record for 10.5281/zenodo.18462699, a DOI tombstoned in the termination. The aggregator carries the work forward after the repository dropped it — which is the platform-erosion asymmetry the Observatory measures, appearing here as a citation. Also: five of eight cards are archive-controlled domains, the highest archive share of any capture read so far.

Operative Architecture: Designed to detect data extraction, preserve semantic autonomy, and build durable meaning objects across platforms and models.
